description: Validates git-secure.ps1 bypass prevention: must strip --no-verify, -n (exact), and combined short flags containing 'n' (e.g., -an, -nm, -anm) to ensure the CodeQL pre-commit hook cannot be bypassed.

command.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$f = '${file}'; if ($f -notmatch 'git-secure\.ps1$') { exit 0 }; $c = Get-Content $f -Raw -ErrorAction Stop; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($c)) { Write-Host '[FAIL] git-secure.ps1 is empty:' $f; exit 2 }; if ($c -notmatch '--no-verify') { Write-Host '[FAIL] git-secure.ps1 does not handle --no-verify flag stripping in' $f; exit 2 }; if ($c -notmatch "'-n'") { Write-Host '[FAIL] git-secure.ps1 does not handle -n flag stripping in' $f; exit 2 }; if ($c -notmatch '\[a-zA-Z\]\*n') { Write-Host '[FAIL] git-secure.ps1 does not handle combined short flags containing n (e.g., -an, -nm) in' $f; exit 2 }; exit 0"
